integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: white phone box bolted on the left wall with its coiled cord looped; steel grate lying face-down on the floor beside the drain; floor dry. [Shot 1] Close insert of a white steel wall telephone box bolted at head height, its coiled cord hanging in a loose loop, and TEO's boots on the wet concrete below. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to the camera cuts to a wide two-shot: TEO lifts the receiver and turns away, the cord snaps taut and the whole phone box is yanked off the wall and tumbles down onto the fallen steel grate, while JUCA shoulders a steel drum past behind him and keeps walking. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to the camera cuts to a tight two-shot: TEO still holds the receiver at his ear on a cord that now leads down to a telephone on the floor. He straightens his spine and raises one flat hand at chest height; behind him the white curtain slides and a military boot steps into the bay. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: phone box torn off the wall and lying on the fallen grate; receiver still in TEO's hand on the cord; a military boot stepping in behind the curtain.
overall_soundscape: A bakelite receiver clicks off its cradle, the coiled cord creaks as it tightens, and the steel phone box bangs down on the concrete and rings. TEO snorts one short nasal breath. JUCA exhales a long flat sigh.
